functions.name: save_svg
functions.doc: SVG 折れ線グラフとして保存（簡易）。幅・高さはピクセル、y は[-1,1]想定でスケール。
functions.source_code: # [doc = " SVG 折れ線グラフとして保存（簡易）。幅・高さはピクセル、y は[-1,1]想定でスケール。"] pub fn save_svg (& self , path : & str , width : u32 , height : u32) -> std :: io :: Result < () > { use std :: fs :: File ; use std :: io :: Write ; let mut f = File :: create (path) ? ; let w = width as f64 ; let h = height as f64 ; writeln ! (f , "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='{width}' height='{height}' viewBox='0 0 {width} {height}'>") ? ; writeln ! (f , "<rect width='100%' height='100%' fill='white' />") ? ; if self . len () > 1 { let max_n = (self . len () - 1) as f64 ; write ! (f , "<polyline fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='1' points='") ? ; for (i , & v) in self . data . iter () . enumerate () { let x = (i as f64 / max_n) * w ; let y = h * (1.0 - (v . clamp (- 1.0 , 1.0) + 1.0) * 0.5) ; write ! (f , "{x:.3},{y:.3} ") ? ; } writeln ! (f , "' />") ? ; } writeln ! (f , "</svg>") ? ; Ok (()) }

functions.name: save_svg_magnitude_db
functions.doc: 対数振幅(dB)の簡易SVGプロット。
functions.source_code: # [doc = " 対数振幅(dB)の簡易SVGプロット。"] pub fn save_svg_magnitude_db (& self , path : & str , width : u32 , height : u32 ,) -> std :: io :: Result < () > { use std :: fs :: File ; use std :: io :: Write ; let mut f = File :: create (path) ? ; let w = width as f64 ; let h = height as f64 ; let n = self . len () ; writeln ! (f , "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='{width}' height='{height}' viewBox='0 0 {width} {height}'>") ? ; writeln ! (f , "<rect width='100%' height='100%' fill='white' />") ? ; if n > 1 { let max_k = (n - 1) as f64 ; write ! (f , "<polyline fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='1' points='") ? ; for (k , c) in self . data . iter () . enumerate () { let x = (k as f64 / max_k) * w ; let mag = c . norm () ; let db = if mag > 0.0 { 20.0 * mag . log10 () } else { - 120.0 } ; let y = h * (1.0 - ((db + 120.0) / 120.0)) ; write ! functions.name: process_sample
functions.source_code: pub fn process_sample (& mut self , input : f64 , desired : f64) -> (f64 , f64) { let n = self . buffer . len () ; self . head = if self . head == 0 { n - 1 } else { self . head - 1 } ; self . buffer [self . head] = input ; let mut y = 0.0 ; for i in 0 .. n { let xi = self . buffer [(self . head + i) % n] ; y += self . weights . data [i] * xi ; } let e = desired - y ; let alpha = 2.0 * self . step_size * e ; for i in 0 .. n { let xi = self . buffer [(self . head + i) % n] ; self . weights . data [i] += alpha * xi ; } (y , e) }

functions.source_code: # [doc = " taps 本数、ステップサイズ mu、正則化 epsilon で初期化"] # [doc = " 典型的には 0 < mu < 2、epsilon は 1e-6 程度"] pub fn new (taps : usize , step_size : f64 , epsilon : f64) -> Self { assert ! (taps > 0) ; assert ! (step_size > 0.0) ; assert ! (epsilon >= 0.0) ; Self { weights : Vector :: zeros (taps) , buffer : vec ! [0.0 ; taps] , head : 0 , step_size , epsilon , } }

functions.name: process_sample
functions.doc: 1 サンプル処理。出力 y と誤差 e を返す。
functions.source_code: # [doc = " 1 サンプル処理。出力 y と誤差 e を返す。"] pub fn process_sample (& mut self , input : f64 , desired : f64) -> (f64 , f64) { let n = self . buffer . len () ; self . head = if self . head == 0 { n - 1 } else { self . head - 1 } ; self . buffer [self . head] = input ; let mut y = 0.0 ; let mut x2 = 0.0 ; for i in 0 .. n { let xi = self . buffer [(self . head + i) % n] ; y += self . weights . data [i] * xi ; x2 += xi * xi ; } let e = desired - y ; let denom = self . epsilon + x2 ; if denom > 0.0 { let alpha = self . step_size * e / denom ; for i in 0 .. n { let xi = self . buffer [(self . head + i) % n] ; self . weights . data [i] += alpha * xi ; } } (y , e) }
